name.fr-FR: Entretiens de saint Vincent de Paul aux Missionnaires
name.en-US: Conferences of St. Vincent de Paul to the Missionaries
name.pt-BR: Colóquios de São Vicente de Paulo aos Missionários

description.fr-FR: Les conférences, répétitions d’oraison, avis et résumés de saint Vincent aux prêtres et aux frères de la Congrégation de la Mission (1617-1660), édités par Pierre Coste (tomes XI-XII) : la vocation du missionnaire, les règles communes, les vertus de la Compagnie, avec les notes de l’éditeur.
description.en-US: The conferences, repetitions of prayer, counsels and summaries of St. Vincent to the priests and brothers of the Congregation of the Mission (1617-1660), edited by Pierre Coste (vols. XI-XII): the missionary vocation, the Common Rules, the virtues of the Company, with the editor’s notes.
description.pt-BR: As conferências, repetições de oração e avisos de São Vicente aos padres e irmãos da Congregação da Missão (1617-1660), editados por Pierre Coste (tomos XI-XII): a vocação do missionário, as regras comuns, as virtudes da Companhia.

sources.edition: Saint Vincent de Paul, Correspondance, entretiens, documents, éd. Pierre Coste C.M., Paris: Gabalda, 1920-1925, tomes XI-XII; digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity (1992), on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All items of Coste’s tomes XI and XII, one per chapter, with Coste’s headnotes and footnotes kept as notes. Coste’s introductions are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Vincent died in 1660; Coste’s edition appeared in 1920-25 and Coste died in 1935. The digital transcription is of the same text, with Coste’s notes.
